subject.title: fix(tavily): forward the execution abort signal to web search HTTP requests

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 own the shared runWebSearch parent-cancellation change, leaving this PR to carry only Tavily-specific propagation?
rationale: Both open branches implement the same shared-runtime invariant, but the SearXNG branch already has positive real held-request proof; choosing one landing branch is an integration decision that code inspection cannot safely make.

options.title: Use SearXNG as canonical
options.body: Select the proof-positive shared hunk from the SearXNG PR, then rebase this PR to Tavily-only propagation and request-level proof.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Keep the shared hunk here only after equivalent real request proof is added and remove the duplicate from the sibling branch.
